title: Golden eyes on pollutants: colorimetric detection of emerging contaminants with AuNPs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32833-32870
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05615B, Review Article
Open Access

Evana Sultana, Muhammad Shamim Al Mamun
The colorimetric identification of emerging pollutants using gold nanoparticles (AuNP) is depicted in the graphical abstract. The simplicity, efficacy, and selectivity of AuNP-based sensing for quick environmental monitoring are summed up.
